info.title: FynePDF API
info.description: PDF tools for apps and agents: the same engines as fynepdf.com. Every error is RFC 9457 problem details; every response carries a Request-Id.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details. Branch on `code`; show `detail` to people.

download_url.description: A signed link valid for one hour; ask again for a fresh one.

status.description: `queued` while the job waits for a free slot, `running` once its first step starts (`started_at` is set then).

Job.description: A file and up to eight steps. A failed or canceled job is refunded in full: you pay only for jobs that succeed.

details.description: What the step found or proved (redact by text: occurrences found, and that none remain).

wait.description: Seconds to wait for the job to finish before answering (0 to 60). Finished jobs answer 200; others 202.

webhook_url.description: An https URL told when the job finishes (Standard Webhooks signatures).

metadata.description: Your own keys and values, returned on the job and in webhooks.

estimate.description: True when pages are only known after converting (non-PDF inputs).

get.description: Which key and account a request runs as, and the limits that apply to it. Costs nothing.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key

429.description: Rate limit reached for this key

get.description: The monthly free allowance (AI steps may use only part of it) and bought credits. Steps spend the free allowance first. Costs nothing.

post.description:
Three ways in:
- `{filename, size}`: get an `upload_url`, then `PUT` the bytes to it (large files never pass through the API).
- `{url}`: we fetch a public URL (redirects followed, private addresses refused).
- `multipart/form-data` with a `file` field: up to 25 MB, ready at once.
Files are deleted after 24 hours, or sooner with `ttl_seconds` or DELETE.

201.description: The file. For an upload URL: `upload_url` to PUT exactly `size` bytes to, valid 15 minutes.

post.summary: Create a PDF from Markdown, HTML or data
post.description:
Write the content, get a well-set PDF: Markdown or HTML, a template (plain, report, invoice, letter, resume) in a quiet or classic style, page size, margins, header, footer and page numbers. Or send an invoice's, resume's or letter's fields as data and we lay it out; an invoice is added up and checked. Takes no input file.

A one-step job (`create_pdf`): 2 credits per 20 pages made (started). Waits up to 30 s for the result by default.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for the result (default 30).

metadata.description: Your own keys and values, returned on the job and in webhooks.

heading.description: Printed at the top. Default "Invoice"; e.g. "Tax invoice", "Quote".

currency.description: An ISO code ("USD", "NPR") for proper formatting, or a symbol ("Rs.").

quantity.description: A number, or text as printed ("1,250.00").

unit_price.description: A number, or text as printed ("1,250.00").

subtotal.description: Left out: the lines added up.

tax.description: Left out: tax_rate of the subtotal after discount.

shipping.description: A number, or text as printed ("1,250.00").

total.description: Left out: subtotal − discount + tax + shipping.

contact.description: Email, phone, city, links: one line, in order.

body.description: Markdown; a blank line starts a paragraph.

data.description: Instead of markdown/html: the fields of an invoice, resume or letter (set template to match). We lay it out; for an invoice we also add up the lines, tax and total and report anything that doesn't add up.

post.description:
Structured data, checked in code where it can be:
- `invoice`: numbers, dates, parties, lines and totals; lines, subtotal, tax and total are added up and compared.
- `statement`: a bank statement's transactions; totals and balances compared with the statement's own figures.
- `tables`: every table, cell by cell, with its page.
- `schema`: your own JSON Schema (an object, up to 20 KB).
`unverified` lists values that couldn't be found in the document's text. Price: 2 credits per page read.
